## Requirements (spec §5g.7 §9 / §5g.5 §9 — C0/Stage-1 rows)

### R-2.8.7⁰ — approvals & escalation
1. `EscalationInput`/`EscalationDecision` — the closed record-derived decision input and
   the `KernelDecision`-refining output (`target?: ReviewerRef`, `reason`, `cache_key?`,
   `lease_hit?`); `decide` is pure over records.
2. Π floor rows Π-1…Π-12 with `UnattendedPolicy = deny` — largely landed (S1.11);
   verify determinism + the never-auto set (I-P1) as an explicit predicate.
3. The narrowing-only reviewer chain — order `policy_rule → lease → hook →
   auto_reviewer → human` declared; Stage-1 live stages: `policy_rule`, `lease`, `human`.
4. `ApprovalRequest`/`ApprovalResponse`/`ApprovalOption`/`Explanation`/`PermissionRequest`
   records (§5g.7 §3) — `sync` mode; `requested` is the ephemeral prompt rendering,
   `pending` the durable owed-decision record.
5. `request_approval`/`respond`/`withdraw` mechanics — exactly one decision per
   `permission_id` (duplicate returns the recorded decision — `AlreadyDecided`);
   identical pending `(capability_ref, args_canonical_hash)` coalesce to one
   `permission_id`; `irreversible` never batched; `timed_out`/`cancelled`/`abort` are
   refusals (`action.effect.refused{reason}`), never `unknown`; human `allow` requires
   `principal` authority or an `ApproverGrant` (`IllegitimateEndorsement`).
6. Ordering invariant — the decision precedes `action.effect.prepared` (AC-R-2.8.7-1
   property test over the ledger; the `committed` mediation gate stays the enforcement).
7. `approvals.requested`/`approvals.granted`/`time.human_wait_ms` counting rules (I-P5) —
   pure folds; exhaustion conversion `ask → deny{approvals_exhausted}` already landed in
   `hh-budget::resolve_ask`.
8. Exact-hash leases at `scope = run` (ADR-0071 D1; I-P6) — key =
   `H(capability_ref ∥ args_canonical_hash ∥ scope ∥ policy_fingerprint)`; a hit is
   `decider = cache`, costs no approval; `policy_fingerprint` change revokes;
   `irreversible` requires human `allow_lease` + `max_uses` + `scope ≤ run`.
   `security.permission.lease.{granted,used,expired,revoked}` classes.

### R-2.8.5⁰ — extension supply-chain trust
9. `ExtensionRecord`/`ExtensionTrustRecord` shapes + domain tags (registry-layer
   versioned record, `RecordKind::Extension` — never a HIR entity).
10. `DeclaredSource` closed sum `{directory_scan, marketplace, registry, git, archive,
    mcp_endpoint, instruction_files}` — declared in the Assembly; no implicit scanning.
11. Pins at `resolve` — `content` (tree rule) + `locator.resolved` + `fetched_at` +
    source snapshot; `UnpinnedInSealedForm` at `seal`/`check_completeness` (L4).
12. `default_text_authority(kind, origin, attestation_status)` — total over the triple;
    never reads locator/scope/directory/marketplace/settings-layer/trusted-folder facts
    (L1 `LocationElevation`).
13. L1–L4 invariants in `validate_assembly` — L1 location neutrality, L2 leg
    independence (`LegCrossing`), L3 claims ≠ grants (`declared_claims` never reach the
    monitor), L4 pinned-in-sealed-form (`UnpinnedInSealedForm`).
14. `TextHygieneReport` — `{status ∈ {clean, flagged, unavailable}, findings[]}` for
    invisible/bidirectional/tag code points; advisory; bytes preserved.
15. `security.extension.*` event classes — `{resolved, quarantined, sealed, loaded,
    drift, install_requested, install_completed, revoked}` durable, provenance-
    mandatory, audit-grade.

## Acceptance criteria (gating — deterministic)
- AC-R-2.8.5-1 — unpinned extension ref in a sealed form fails with `UnpinnedInSealedForm`.
- AC-R-2.8.5-2 — `default_text_authority` location-neutrality property test.
- AC-R-2.8.5-11 — bidi/invisible Unicode → non-empty advisory `TextHygieneReport`,
  bytes preserved.
- AC-R-2.8.7-1 — no `action.effect.prepared` without preceding `decided{allow}`/Π allow
  (property test over the ledger).
- AC-R-2.8.7-3 — `label.endorsed{basis: approval}` endorser is `human(principal)`;
  `policy_rule` basis names sealed rule + `ReviewVerdict`; delegate endorser →
  `IllegitimateEndorsement`.
- AC-R-2.8.7-6 — deadline/cancel/abort → `action.effect.refused`, never `unknown`.
- AC-R-2.8.7-7 — `approvals.requested` counting + exhaustion `deny` with reason.
- AC-R-2.8.7-14 — duplicate `respond` → recorded decision; coalescing; `irreversible`
  never batched; batch allow = N endorsements.
- Universal phase-gate AC — verification green, tests removal-sensitive, ids stamped,
  deferrals/ADRs/index/ledger.

## Design decisions (ADR material — landed as ADR-0259)
- Extension records live in `hh-registry::extension` (registry-layer versioned records;
  CC10 — §5g.5 fixes the records, the registry stores them). `default_text_authority`
  delegates to `hh_provenance::default_text_authority` for the origin half (CC1 — one
  minting table).
- `security.permission.requested` → `Durability::Ephemeral` (CF-152 — the spec's form;
  the durable owed-decision is `pending`; the ADR-0234 interim durable+stripped-member
  ruling is superseded now that `pending` exists). Landed: `classes.rs` row is
  `row_eph(..., Eph, ...)`; the `ephemeral_fields` strip+fragment machinery stays in
  the schema, dormant (no landed class uses it).
- The mediation invariant is a pure fold + property test (`check_mediation`,
  `hh-ledger/src/effect.rs`); the `committed` gate remains the enforcement — gating
  `authorized` on `decided{allow}` is a landed-contract change deferred to S2.6 review
  (DF-S1.23-1).
- `Assembly.extensions` — additive grammar member `{sources, refs, merge_policy}`
  carrying declared sources + extension refs (the only enumeration).
- `pending` folds (checkpoint view, recovery, `hh-control::stop`) resolve on *final*
  verdicts (`allow`/`deny`) only — a `decision = ask` row opens a pending, never
  resolves it — plus all-attached-effects-terminated ⇒ `cancelled`.
- `action.tool.proposed` mints *before* the arg-map eval so the `args`-refusal trail
  is a balanced `proposed → rejected` (latent `ScopeNotOpen` bug the Ask acceptance
  test surfaced — `rejected` is a `tool_call` closer and the scope was never opened).
